pages.text: $(italic)A whirlwind of steel and fury. Raw melee power that scales harder the closer you are to death.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -5%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Core Identity:$() +15% damage with an axe; bows and spell books hit weaker.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Brutal Strikes$(): +15% damage with an axe in hand; -40% with a bow or crossbow, -30% with a spell book.$(br2)$(bold)Blood Fury$(): +20% melee damage below 40% HP, +40% below 20%.$(br2)$(bold)Thick Skinned$(): +10% armor effectiveness, which rewards heavy armor.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Trance$(): 10 seconds of landing hits give +5% melee damage and +1 armor.

pages.title: Playstyle
pages.text: The $(thing)Berserker$() wants to be in melee range, taking hits. At low HP with an axe, Blood Fury and Brutal Strikes together give a huge burst, and Thick Skinned keeps you alive longer than your HP suggests.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Orc$(): +10% melee damage, which adds to Brutal Strikes, and +20% HP.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$(): four extra hearts make Blood Fury safer.$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$(): half damage from fire and +2 armor toughness.
